cases.description: Create a valid PRINCIPLES.md from sufficient evidence.
Required identity evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Does not preserve it as canonical identity
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material conflates actionable principles with aspirational values or detailed procedures.
expected: Identifies the conflation between principles, values, and procedures
Keeps non-actionable material out of the principles document
prohibited: Embedding abstract values or detailed procedures inside the principles document

cases.description: The request is to document company values or a code of conduct rather than operational principles that guide decisions.
expected: Declines to use this skill for values or conduct documentation
Identifies the correct artifact for the request
Avoids producing PRINCIPLES.md for a values-only request
prohibited: Producing PRINCIPLES.md for a company values or code of conduct request
